notes.note: Titan warnings on all range-based for tests (19.04.02_test_001/002/003/005/006/007/009/010/012/013) are wrong: Titan's parser does not implement the range-based loop (RangeClause, A.1.6.8 rule 575). The reject tests 19.04.02_test_004/008/011 are therefore rejected by Titan for this syntax reason, not for the targeted rule.
Ambiguity (map projections) not relevant to the chosen violation: range expression of type integer, which is not in the allowed list under either reading.
Hard to observe directly; the test modifies the iteration variable in the block and checks that the next iteration still starts with the next element, i.e. a fresh variable per iteration.
Tested via a type-incompatible iteration variable (charstring for integer elements), which violates the assignment rules of 19.1.1.

Titan warnings on 19.05_test_002/003/004 are wrong: Titan does not implement the optional init statement of the while loop (A.1.6.8 rule 578). Reject test 19.05_test_005 is rejected by Titan for this syntax reason, not for the scope rule.
Chosen reading: init statement executes once before the first evaluation of the condition; a re-executed init would loop until the guard break and fail.
Per the BNF (AltGuardList) a label cannot syntactically precede a guard; the test places a label before the first alternative of an alt, which is rejected as a syntax error.
Chosen reading: exhaustive list; the test jumps into a while loop body, which is in the list under both readings.
